children: 93% growth in Mobile Data Collector subscriptions to the Company’s data center for video analysis and storage during fiscal year 2026.

Abbotsford, BC – September 1, 2026 – TheNewswire - Gatekeeper Systems Inc. (“Gatekeeper” or the “Company”) (TSX-V:GSI) (OTC:GKPRF), a leader in video and data solutions for school buses, public transit and smart cities, provides an operational update on Mobile Data Collectors (MDCs) installed and subscribed at the end of the Company’s fiscal year, August 31, 2026.

The number of MDC subscriptions to the Company’s data center offerings grew from approximately 4,000 to 7,700 during the Company’s fiscal year ended August 31, 2026. The Company’s data center offerings are monthly recurring subscriptions to a suite of video analytics and storage solutions including Live View Wireless, Student Protector, Passenger Protector, remote monitoring, and video storage.

The Company also reports over 7,000 MDCs were installed on school buses and transit vehicles during the fiscal year, with the majority being installed on school buses. The aggregate installed base of customer-owned Gatekeeper MDCs is now estimated at approximately 72,000.

Doug Dyment, President and CEO of Gatekeeper, commented: “Since launching our data center in February 2024, we have witnessed steady adoption of our recurring revenue offerings, which we continue to improve in response to our customers’ needs. Our customers value the simplicity of choosing Gatekeeper for video analysis and storage, which is driven by the increasing use of video, rising costs of video storage, and the overall complexity of manually conducting video reviews. Our centralized data center approach simplifies the customer’s capital infrastructure cost burden into a simple operating budget recurring revenue subscription model, and it also significantly reduces the time required to get a customer’s video system fully operational. The data center is integrated with Gatekeeper’s AI-assisted video analytics software tools for incident flagging and adherence to privacy laws for video storage of school student images, and allowing customers to generate video snippets, blur facial images, analyze video and more.”

Gatekeeper is a leading provider of video and data solutions for a safer transportation environment for children, passengers, and drivers on public transportation fleets. Gatekeeper has provided solutions to more than 60 transit agencies and 3,500 school districts throughout North America and has installed approximately 72,000 Mobile Data Collectors for customers which record video and data daily from over 200,000 onboard devices. The Company’s hosted software applications facilitate AI-assisted video analytics for incident management and storage. The Company’s Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model is centered around the Mobile Data Collectors, which are the cornerstone of its data company transformation. www.gatekeeper-systems.com
